notes.title: Villain Update: We made the bad guy spookier.
notes.notes:
Modified the villain's main area actions so it will follow you if you sprint.
Also made it look significantly better.

notes.title: Bug Fix! Show Little Less E
notes.notes: The standard "E" to interact drawing that appears when Val is close enough to interact with objects should now only show up in full color once she can actually interact. Otherwise there is a more greyed out version to indicate that you can interact with this item once you have something else or wait for something to finish.
